findings.title: Local discovery resolves credentials during command assembly
findings.description: Constructing auth login invokes f.Config() to choose the --domain help brand before discover runs. Under authsidecar this resolves the current account and sends a user_info identity request for every local discovery. The selected immutable process test logged user=5 for one guide-show plus four discovery calls, despite discovery declaring that it never resolves credentials. Missing/slow credential enrichment can therefore add network work/latency to local command inspection, and existing zero-business-request assertions do not catch it.
findings.requested_change: Use already selected startup/build/catalog brand for command help metadata instead of resolving credential-backed config during discovery assembly, while retaining correct profile/brand help. Add a real-process discovery/help test asserting zero credential and business requests.
